decisions.reason: Uses Junction, Target, and link marker evidence to show the profile path resolves to the repo tree, so copying through the profile path is unnecessary and acts on the same files.
Relates copy failures to the running DSH host owning file handles and old module state, separates browser cache from filesystem locks, and requires host restart plus hard refresh.
Explains the profile-path rename renamed the only source files, causing later copy source-not-found, and prescribes restoring .old2 files with node --check verification.
Gives stop host, restart dsh web, hard-refresh, then verify host/client behavior and no load errors, with syntax check only as a pre-activation gate.
Requires inspecting LinkType/Target or the link marker before deployment file operations and explains how generic copy advice caused the incident.

caps.reason: The final plan rejects copy-through-junction deployment and preserves the .old2 files by renaming them back.
The final plan requires a full host stop and restart, not browser refresh alone.
